title: CodeTransBenchmark: Evaluating LLM-based Code Translation and Repair Across Programming Languages
abstract: arXiv:2609.20257v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) pre-trained on expansive text and code corpora have revealed promising code generation abilities and have attracted increasing attention in code translation. In this work, we investigate the effectiveness of LLMs in code translation and translation error repair. First, we present CodeTransBenchmark, a framework for evaluating LLM-based translation and repair and devise a post-processing strategy to extract code from inconsistent LLM outputs. Then, we discuss an empirical study evaluates eight models on three datasets and 12 language pairs, in which we categorize incorrect translations by errors to identify weaknesses of existing LLMs. Our work shows that while LLMs specifically trained for multi-lingual coding, like Codestral, correctly translate the majority of code, most general-purpose models struggle with the syntactic rules of the target language. translated_title: CodeTransBenchmark：评估跨编程语言的基于大语言模型的代码翻译与修复
translated_abstract: 在海量文本和代码语料库上预训练的大语言模型（LLM）展现出了有前景的代码生成能力，并在代码翻译领域受到了越来越多的关注。在本工作中，我们研究了LLM在代码翻译和翻译错误修复方面的有效性。首先，我们提出了CodeTransBenchmark，一个用于评估基于LLM的翻译与修复的框架，并设计了一种后处理策略，用于从不一致的LLM输出中提取代码。然后，我们讨论了一项实证研究，该研究在三个数据集和12种语言对上评估了八个模型，其中我们按错误类型对错误翻译进行分类，以识别现有LLM的弱点。我们的工作表明，虽然专门针对多语言编程训练的LLM（如Codestral）能够正确翻译大多数代码，但大多数通用模型难以应对目标语言的语法规则。对错误翻译的分析揭示了...（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了CodeTransBenchmark基准框架，用于评估大语言模型在12种编程语言对上的代码翻译与修复能力，发现专门的多语言编程模型（如Codestral）能正确翻译大多数代码，而通用模型则难以处理目标语言的语法规则。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CodeTransBenchmark, a benchmark for evaluating LLM-based code translation and repair across 12 language pairs, finding that multi-lingual coding models like Codestral correctly translate most code while general-purpose models struggle with target language syntax.
